releaseNotes: Fixes the app closing when zooming in on the offline OpenStreetMap basemap. Deep zoom offline now stays stretched instead of going blank. The offline map download area now covers all of Region XII with margin (about 1 GB).
windowsReleaseNotes: Offline admin mode: admins can now sign in, edit polygon attributes and upload shapefiles while offline. Changes are saved on this PC and sent automatically when the server is reachable again (see Pending in the More menu). Big uploads no longer use huge amounts of memory.
